movie.title: The Poet And The Spy
movie.overview: In 1919 Fiume, Russian spy Beatrice navigates political turmoil while protecting poet Gabriele D’Annunzio, entangling with an intelligence chief and a WWI deserter amid Italy’s revolutionary unrest.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Set in 1919 Fiume, a Russian spy named Beatrice navigates high-stakes political intrigue and romantic entanglements while protecting the charismatic poet Gabriele D’Annunzio during Italy's post-WWI revolutionary unrest.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In 1919, amidst the chaotic political turmoil of Fiume following World War I, Russian spy Beatrice is tasked with safeguarding the enigmatic Italian poet and nationalist Gabriele D’Annunzio. As revolutionary fervor sweeps through Italy, Beatrice finds herself caught in a dangerous web of espionage, loyalty, and betrayal. Her mission grows increasingly complex as she becomes entangled with a calculating intelligence chief and a disillusioned WWI deserter. To survive, she must balance her personal desires with the volatile forces shaping a nation on the brink.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Following the devastation of World War I, the city of Fiume becomes a hotbed of nationalist passion and revolutionary fervor in 1919. At the center of this storm is Gabriele D’Annunzio, a larger-than-life poet whose radical ideals draw both passionate followers and deadly enemies. Russian spy Beatrice is covertly deployed to the city to protect D’Annunzio from powerful covert forces seeking to exploit the chaos. As she operates in the shadows of the city, Beatrice must navigate a treacherous landscape populated by foreign operatives, political conspirators, and local insurgents. Her allegiance is put to the ultimate test when she forms a tense relationship with a cunning intelligence chief who plays every side for personal gain. Simultaneously, her bond deepens with a WWI deserter seeking redemption amidst the societal collapse. Balancing high-stakes covert ops with romantic entanglements, Beatrice struggles to maintain her cover as factions clash over the fate of Fiume. Each move she makes threatens to ignite a larger conflict across Europe as the line between ally and enemy blurs. Ultimately, Beatrice must choose where her true loyalties lie in a world teetering on the edge of revolution.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Poet And The Spy is an evocative historical drama and romantic thriller set in 1919 during the tumultuous occupation of Fiume. World War I has left Europe fractured, and in Italy, nationalist agitation reaches a boiling point under the influence of the poet, aviator, and charismatic leader Gabriele D’Annunzio. Operating amidst this dangerous political backdrop is Beatrice, a skilled Russian operative tasked with keeping D’Annunzio safe from hidden threats. As rival factions fight for control over the city, Beatrice navigates a dangerous maze of political maneuvering, intelligence warfare, and passionate romance involving a powerful intelligence officer and a world-weary deserter. Combining historical detail with thrilling suspense, the story explores the cost of freedom, love, and loyalty in a time of radical transformation.

story_structure.risingAction: As revolutionary unrest mounts in Fiume, secret intelligence plots thicken, forcing Beatrice to pull off increasingly risky tactical maneuvers to stay ahead of rival factions.
